newsitem.title: GERMANY: Record sales boost Adidas profits.
newsitem.headline: Record sales boost Adidas profits.

text.p: German sporting good maker Adidas AG Tuesday reported record sales for 1996 and said its business outlook for this year was strong.
It said operating profits rose to 360 million marks ($211.4 million) in 1996 from 243 million marks ($143 million) in 1995.
Sales climbed 35 percent during the year to 4.71 billion marks ($2.8 billion).

European sales were especially strong, climbing to 3.1 billion marks ($1.8 billion) from 2.3 billion marks ($1.4 billion) -- the first time European sales were over three billion marks ($1.76 billion).
Chairman Robert Louis-Dreyfus said the results showed that Adidas was on the way to becoming the "best sports brand in the world."
